title: Num Lock Indicator on lock and login screens
line: After a wrong password, the lock and login screens now say "Num Lock is on" when it is.
explanation: The lock screen, the SDDM Breeze theme and the Plasma Login Manager greeter only ever warned about Caps Lock. On laptops whose letter keys type digits with Num Lock on (and often have no LED), a wrong password gave no hint why it was rejected. Each screen now also watches Num Lock with the same KeyState used for Caps Lock and, once a password has been rejected, shows "Num Lock is on" in the same status line for as long as Num Lock stays on.

commits.message:
lockscreen, sddm-theme: show Num Lock state after a failed login

A rejected password gave no hint that Num Lock was on, which is easy to
miss on laptops where it turns letters into digits. Show it after a
failed attempt, not before, as many keyboards keep it on all the time.

BUG: 391168

greeter: show Num Lock state after a failed login

A rejected password gave no hint that Num Lock was on, which is easy to
miss on laptops where it turns letters into digits. Show it after a
failed attempt, not before, as many keyboards keep it on all the time.

BUG: 391168

reviews.text: Smart, HIG-friendly UX solution that shows "Num Lock is on" only after a failed unlock or login attempt, solving the laptop-without-LED lockout problem out of the box without adding an extra setting or nagging desktop users who keep Num Lock on. The implementation consistently reuses KeyboardIndicator.KeyState and the existing status line across LockScreenUi, the SDDM Breeze theme, and Plasma Login Manager, with proper i18n domains and interactive-authenticator filtering. A minor nitpick is that sddm-theme's secondary userPromptComponent ("Other…") still binds root.notificationMessage directly (as it already did for Caps Lock), unlike plasma-login-manager which covers both views, but both patches are clean and ready for MR.
